preconditions.description: The input must be a string.
The length of the name must be between 1 and 9 characters.

postconditions.description: The matrix is a perfect square, meaning the number of rows is equal to the number of columns.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(row, list) and all(isinstance(char, str) for char in row) for row in matrix)
postconditions.description: Each element in the matrix is a string.
The name length is either even or exactly one character long.
The total number of characters in the matrix is equal to the length of the name.

postconditions.expression: all(char == '.' or char in name for row in matrix for char in row)
postconditions.description: Each character in the matrix is either a period or a character from the name.
If the name is empty, the function returns the message 'name must be at least one letter'.
